activity.notes: After Maria Theresa's death in 1780, Joseph II became the sole ruler of the Habsburg Monarchy and remained so until his death in 1790. ATLAS records this as a separate rules/reign Activity rather than extending the preceding co-regency across the entire 1765-1790 period. Joseph's simultaneous office as Holy Roman Emperor is historically distinct from this Habsburg Monarchy Activity.

sources.title: Joseph II — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: Die Welt der Habsburger identifies Joseph II as co-regent in the Habsburg Monarchy from 1765 to 1780 and sole regent from 1780 to 1790.

sources.title: Rule by mother and son: Joseph II and Maria Theresa — Die Welt der Habsburger
sources.citation_text: The Habsburg history project explains that Joseph functioned as co-regent in the hereditary lands until Maria Theresa's death in 1780, after which the joint-rule phase ended.
